info.title: An Cu Auth0 VNeID
info.description: SWP VNeID simulation. Account verification VERIFIED; source AUTH0_VNEID_SIMULATION. Asset import is not implemented by these routes.

get.summary: Read own persisted verification methods and verified citizen details
get.description: Self account derived only from internal JWT/session. Returns emailVerified and vneid {status, verifiedAt, identity}. identity is null when UNVERIFIED; VERIFIED identity contains documentNumber, legalName, dateOfBirth (ISO date), gender, address. No issuer/subject/tokens/images exposed. Reads existing evidence even when new Auth0 login is disabled; does not modify self-declared identity dossiers.

200.description: Per-method status and private read-only citizen; Cache-Control no-store
enabled, issuer, clientId, audience, connection; no-store

post.summary: Register CUSTOMER or sign in an already linked external identity
post.description: Requires Auth0 RS256 access token for configured audience/client/source/connection and CSRF cookie/header. Does not auto-link matching email/CCCD. Returns existing TokenResponse shape and rotates internal refresh credential. Creates no password and does not set emailVerified. No citizen JSON accepted as proof.

200.description: accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, user; opaque HttpOnly SameSite refresh cookie; no-store

post.summary: Link and verify only the currently signed-in account
post.description: Internal session JWT in Authorization; separate Auth0 access token in JSON, excluded from logging. Requires CSRF. Same link retry is idempotent; existing dossier/profile/contract snapshot not overwritten; no role or Property approval change.

400.description: Unknown JSON fields or invalid/missing citizen claims

401.description: Invalid internal session or external token

409.description: Identity belongs to another account or different identity already linked
